short: Shared library, cut by the runes seam
is: The shared library, cut by the seam: `api`/`types`/`components`/`testing` are Effect-free and browser-safe; `server/` is the Effect half.
conventions: `$lib/api/*` is the vocabulary that crosses the seam — plain interfaces + `as const` maps.
A rule stated once lives in the shared module both sides import (`handle-format.ts` backs both the Schema field and the brand validator).
Components name a token, never a raw colour or a palette custom property; core components use the design language's names exactly (`ui/`), and the frame's compositions live in `explorer/`.
Icons are inline SVG path data copied from Lucide (ISC) into `components/ui/icons.ts`, always `aria-hidden` beside words.

A `DenHref` is minted only by the Den path builder (`server/den/den-path.ts`) and the bare-root fallback (`components/explorer/den-root.ts`) — eslint enforces it for every spelling of the brand module (any relative path, any extension, and dynamic `import()`); components render Den links, never build them.

fs.name: api/
fs.role: component-facing plain-data contracts: Problem (COMMISSION_NOT_FOUND_PROBLEM among the backend's own, field for field; with its field errors: errors, FieldError, and invalidFieldsProblem mirroring the backend's refused-fields 422), Session, Account, Trail (the path bar's steps: a Den link or a fixed section page, a named step with its name's number), the Den view (den.ts: DenPageData — entries, crumbs and the opened node carry a bare name and its own ordinal, never a composed "name (n)" —, its full shape check isDenPageData, DenOutcome, DenEntry…, DenThing — the commission an open page stands for, by its id, cardTypeWord — a card's type as a word for exactly account/character/commission, none otherwise) and its root route (den-route.ts, pinned to an app with no base path), the sign-out notice (signout.ts: the unconfirmed-sign-out address and its words), HttpStatus, API_PREFIX, FetchFunction; the bug report (bug-report.ts: BUG_REPORT_FIELDS — the field names the dialog and the report page post —, BugReportActionData — sent with its reference, or a failure kind carrying the reporter's text — and its runtime check isBugReportActionData, BugReportOffer, ARCHIVED_SUFFIX, TestStack — the kind of stack the web runs on: dev profile, mock or neither)

fs.name: components/
fs.role: ProblemNote (the one way a problem renders) + SessionHeader (public pages); `ui/` = the design language's core components by their names (Button, IconButton, Icon, PathBar, Avatar, Dialog — modal, drawer or full screen on a phone (by base.css's switches), with a chosen initial focus, a return-focus target and a footer outside its scrolling body — EmptyState, TreeItem, Toggle, Checkbox — its value and any note read with it —, TextInput — never length-capped, a multi-line one at least six rows, read with its hint, its error and any further descriptions it names —, InlineMessage — info or error in a live status region, its element bindable so its owner can bring it into view — Badge, VisibilityMarker, Skeleton — each placeholder row as tall as --row-height — and ShownName, a Den name in its <bdi> with " (n)" outside it, whose text twin for the live region, tooltips and aria labels is shown-name.ts's shownNameText, the name in U+2068…U+2069 with " (n)" outside); `explorer/` = the signed-in frame's own compositions (AppShell, TopBar — ☰ a bindable prop, so the frame gives it focus back —, Sidebar, Tree + TreeBranch, ViewOptions, NodeHeader, EntryList, DenPane, NewCommission (the create dialog, shown only on the viewer's own commissions folder), RenameCommission (the rename dialog, shown only on an open node standing for a commission: Title starts from the node's bare name, never the shown "name (n)", a hidden field carries the thing's id, and its action carries the page's "Show archived" flag), ErrorView with its fixed copy in error-copy.ts — inside the frame, "Report this problem" beside "Back to My Den" —, ReportBugButton — "Report a bug": the link that opens the dialog, in the top bar and in the phone drawer's footer (the drawer shut first, focus back to ☰); on the report page it focuses the text box, or, with a report just sent, loads the page afresh; and as the error view's "Report this problem", adding the status —, ReportBugDialog, ReportBugForm — the form the dialog and the report page share: a refusal about a field said on it and focused, any other in the status region, scrolled into view —, SentWithReport — the "Sent with your report" tick boxes) and the tree's memory, model and loader; the frame's bug report (bug-report.svelte.ts: the BugReport context — open, the draft, the snapshot re-read at each open, the opener —, the BugReportDraft both forms keep, the items offered (the error view's "Error" item only for a whole 400 to 599, its page type "Error page") and outcomeOf, the form's line for a stack that keeps no reports, the exhaustive reading of an action's answer, and where each refusal is said: on its field or in the status region)

fs.name: navigation.ts
fs.role: loadFullPage — leave for an http(s) location by a full page load, never the client router; any other address is refused (a seam specs mock; navigation.spec.ts)

fs.name: server/
fs.role: the Effect half — runtime, API port, programs, form schemas

fs.name: styles/
fs.role: tokens.css + base.css (imported once by the root layout) and the contrast gate: declared dark-theme colour pairs checked at WCAG 2.2 AA

fs.name: testing/
fs.role: spec-only harnesses: fetch stub, hanging fetch (a backend that never answers until the signal aborts), kit-fetch (SvelteKit's real server event.fetch, through its internals), problem-body builder, redirect assert, superform prop stub, kit-client (a stand-in for SvelteKit's client runtime: a form posts through the real enhance, an action's data decodes, and navigations, invalidations and applied results are recorded, not done)

fs.name: types/
fs.role: branded primitives (brand.ts — the one blessed `as` site: ids, handles, PathSegment, the opaque CommissionId, DenHref/DenName/DenType, NameOrdinal via the validated nameOrdinal (a whole number of 2 or more), PageToken, FieldPointer via the validated fieldPointer, FirstPartyOrigin, BugReference) + Effect-free rules shared by both sides (handle-format.ts, segment-format.ts, bug-report-rules.ts — a bug report's field parsers, limits, closed page-type list, pageTypeOf — a path's page type —, and the browser text's 512-byte cut)
